results.title: Nimba’s Championship Legitimacy Questioned After Lofa Ruling
results.description: Nimba County’s 2025/2026 National County Sports Meet football championship has come under fresh scrutiny following a Ministry of Youth and Sports ruling that found Lofa County was improperly eliminated from the competition, prompting calls for Nimba to surrender the trophy.

results.title: ‘Thank you tennis’ – Fans are in awe of Ben Shelton and Carlos Alcaraz after epic US Open clash

results.title: [UPDATED] Alcaraz falls to Shelton in epic latest-ever US Open finish
results.description: NEW YORK: Carlos Alcaraz tumbled out of the US Open quarter-finals at 3:34 am Wednesday, falling to Ben Shelton in an epic five-set thriller that broke the record for latest finish ever at Flushing Meadows.
